Game Overview

At its heart, Pool Float Party is a girls' game about join Blondie and Marie as they throw a splash-tastic pool party. Mix cocktails, clean, and design the ultimate poolside bash. Customize their looks with trendy outfits and accessories, and pick the perfect inflatable raft. Dive into creativity and fun with this sunny summer adventure!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Pool Float Party is easy to pick up. Join Blondie and Marie as they throw a splash-tastic pool party! Mix cocktails, clean, and design the ultimate poolside bash. Customize their looks with trendy outfits and accessories, and pick the perfect inflatable raft. Dive into creativity and fun with this sunny summer adventure!
